end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and household objects.
Practised identifying flat and curved faces.
Used cylinder and cone to explain a rocket design.
Asha revisited the difference between cubes and longer cuboids; the mix-up remained at the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised spotting solid shapes in toys and household objects, using their features and positions to explain choices. They clearly described a rocket with a cylinder body and cone tip, and identified a rolling pin and candle as cylinders. They mixed up cuboids and cubes, and sometimes treated turning a shape as changing its name; these were not corrected by the last example. At home, compare a dice with a longer box and check whether all three measurements are equal before calling it a cube.
